description: This file defines the MigrateSourceInterface interface for Drupal's migration system, specifying methods and constants for migrate sources.

classes.name: MigrateSourceInterface
classes.description: Interface for migrate sources, extending Countable, Iterator, and PluginInspectionInterface, defining methods for source fields, row preparation, string conversion, ID definitions, and source module retrieval.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns available fields on the source, with keys as machine names and values as descriptions.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Adds additional data to a row; can return FALSE to skip the row.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Defines how the object reacts when treated as a string.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines source fields that uniquely identify a source row.

methods.name: getSourceModule
methods.description: Retrieves the source module providing the data.
